$comment: Hand-written notes for scripts/kb/gen-server-handbook.ts, Build 42.22 (revision 3d39148846). Each note says what the code does with an option or command, in one line, and names the site it was read from (<class or Lua file>#<method or function>, one of the item's sites in server-surface-42.22.json, or 'declaration'). The generator refuses a note whose site is not one of the item's sites.

MaxPlayers.effect: `ServerOptions#getMaxPlayers` returns the smaller of this value and 254, a cap written into the code.

PingLimit.effect: 0 turns it off. Above 0, a player whose ping is higher than this value is kicked while loading, unless their role has `CantBeKickedIfTooLaggy`. A connected player is also kicked once at least 20 of their last 60 pings (one is taken per second) are above the limit and their average ping of those 60, each counted as at most 1000, is above it too.

SaveWorldEveryMinutes.effect: 0 turns it off. Above 0, once this many real minutes have passed since the last save the server queues a full save, and runs it when no backup is in progress.

PauseEmpty.effect: On the server, the game counts as paused while no player is connected and this is true.

SpeedLimit.effect: On a multiplayer client the engine stops pushing a car forward once it reaches this speed in km/h. The speed anti-cheat also uses it as the limit for a player in a vehicle (`AntiCheatSpeed#validate`, 20 for a player on foot).

CarEngineAttractionModifier.effect: On the server, the loudness of the world sound a running engine makes is multiplied by this value. The roll that decides whether a sound is made is also scaled by it (1 in 120 times the value, before the game-speed factor).

PVPMeleeDamageModifier.effect: On the server, the damage of a melee weapon hit on a character's body is multiplied by this value. Before that, the damage is the weapon's random damage times 15 (times 4 more on the head or neck, 2 on the upper torso).

PVPFirearmDamageModifier.effect: On the server, the damage of a ranged weapon hit on a character's body is multiplied by this value. Before that, the damage is the weapon's random damage times 15 (times 4 more on the head or neck, 2 on the upper torso).

BadWordPolicy.effect: When the word filter flags a chat message, the server bans (1), kicks (2) or logs (3) the sender. The range is 1 to 3, so the "4 - mute" in the description cannot be set: a 4 in the file is refused and the value stays where it was.

WebhookAddress.effect: When it is not empty, the server starts a `StackBot` with this address at start-up. It is not one of the options kept off the public list, so its value is written to every joining player along with the other public options.

ItemNumbersLimitPerContainer.effect: 0 turns it off. Above 0, a multiplayer client shows the item count against the limit beside a container's weight, except for the player's own main inventory. The transfer action counts the destination's items against the limit (`ISInventoryTransferAction:isValid`) and leaves out a destination that belongs to a character. All its read sites are client Lua.

FastForwardMultiplier.effect: While the server is fast-forwarding, `GameTime#getMultiplier` starts from this value times the day length in minutes divided by 30, then applies the usual speed and frame-rate factors. A multiplayer client does the same while it is fast-forwarding.

SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim.effect: 0 turns it off. Above 0, and with `PlayerSafehouse` on, a player who has survived fewer than this many days (hours survived below the value times 24) cannot claim a safehouse. The same rule blocks renaming a safehouse and handing it to a player who has not survived that long, and a role with `CanSetupSafehouses` skips it. With `AdminSafehouse` on, `allowSafeHouse` ignores the days and asks only for the `CanSetupSafehouses` capability.

FactionDaySurvivedToCreate.effect: 0 turns it off. Otherwise a player needs at least this many days survived (hours survived of at least the value times 24) to create a faction, unless their role has `FactionCheat`.

MaxAccountsPerUser.effect: 0 or less turns it off, and so does a server not running in Steam mode. Otherwise the server counts the other accounts that use the same SteamID, in the whitelist and in the player database, and allows a new one only while both counts are below this value; a SteamID whose whitelist role has `PriorityLogin` is always allowed.

SafeHouseRemovalTime.effect: A number of hours: the code multiplies it by 3,600,000 milliseconds. 0 turns removal off; otherwise `SafeHouse#update` releases every safehouse that `isSafeHouseExpired` reports as expired and tells every player.

BloodSplatLifespanDays.effect: This server option is read nowhere. The sandbox option with the same name, `BloodSplatLifespanDays`, is the one `IsoChunk` and `IsoObject` read.

ZombieRespawn.effect: No game code reads it. Choosing a value on the server settings screen fills in three advanced values: `ZombieConfig.RespawnHours` 16, 72, 216 or 0, `ZombieConfig.RespawnUnseenHours` 6, 16, 48 or 0, and `ZombieConfig.RespawnMultiplier` 0.5, 0.1, 0.05 or 0 (for High, Normal, Low and None). Those three are what the game reads.

ZombieMigrate.effect: No game code reads it. Ticking it on the server settings screen sets `ZombieConfig.RedistributeHours` to 12.0, unticking it sets 0.0; the game reads that value.

DayLength.effect: Real minutes per in-game day: choice 1 is 15, 2 is 30, 3 is 60, 4 is 90, and from 5 up it is (choice minus 3) times 60.

RuralLooted.effect: When `DaysUntilMaximumLooted` is above 0, on a square outside every town region the looted chance is multiplied by this value after it is cut to a whole number: anything below 1.0 gives 0 (the chance then becomes its floor of 1), 1.0 to 1.99 leaves it unchanged, 2.0 doubles it. The diminished-loot percentage (`getCurrentDiminishedLootPercentage`) is cut the same way, and there below 1.0 means none.

MaximumLooted.effect: The looted chance grows with the whole days since the world began: this value times the days, divided by `DaysUntilMaximumLooted`, with the days capped at that number. 0 turns it off, and a `DaysUntilMaximumLooted` of 0 gives the full value from the first day, without the rural and Rich changes or the floor of 1. Otherwise a "Rich" square gets 1.5 times, and the result is at least 1.

MultiplierConfig.GlobalToggle.effect: In `IsoGameCharacter.XP#AddXP`, for a gain that takes the XP boost (the ordinary `AddXP` call), when this is true the gain is multiplied by `MultiplierConfig.Global`; when it is false, by the skill's own `MultiplierConfig.<skill>` value.

MultiplierConfig.Global.effect: Multiplies the XP gain in `IsoGameCharacter.XP#AddXP` while `MultiplierConfig.GlobalToggle` is true, for a gain that takes the XP boost. The per-skill values are used only when it is false.

HoursForCorpseRemoval.effect: 0 or less: the corpse pass does nothing. Otherwise each rot stage of a human corpse lasts a third of this many hours, and of an animal corpse a quarter. A human corpse is removed at this age and a skeleton one rot stage later (a player's only when `RemovePlayerCorpsesOnCorpseRemoval` is true). Quirk: the pass sets the quarter-length stage at the first animal corpse and never sets it back, so human corpses handled after an animal in the same pass use a quarter instead of a third. The pass runs everywhere except on a multiplayer client.

DaysForRottenFoodRemoval.effect: -1 turns it off. From 0 up, rotten food is destroyed once its age passes the age at which it rots (`OffAgeMax`) by this many days, unless it sits in a compost bin. Food with a rotten replacement turns into that first, and a multiplayer client does none of this.

NatureAbundance.effect: Foraging reads it through a variable: `forageSystem.getRefillBonus` looks up `SandboxVars[abundanceSetting]`, and the forage zones in `forageZones.lua` set `abundanceSetting` to "NatureAbundance" (it is also the fallback). The refill bonus is 1 plus one hundredth of the matching entry in `forageSystem.abundanceSettings`.

Farming.effect: Not read: the only `SandboxVars.Farming` lines that read it, in `media/lua/server/Farming/farming_vegetableconf.lua`, are commented out (challenge and debug scenario scripts only assign it). Every "Farming" listed above is the skill, a loot type or a crafting category, not this option.

Map.AllowMiniMap.effect: The minimap is allowed only when the world map is allowed and this is true. The default is false, so a server that keeps the defaults has no minimap: see [the missing minimap](/pz/build-42/modding/multiplayer/missing-minimap-check-the-sandbox-first).

additem.effect: A count above 100 is lowered to 100 (the server prints "Cannot spawn over 100 items at a time").

createhorde.effect: The count is capped at 500. Each zombie is placed on a random square up to 10 tiles from the player on each axis, on the player's floor, and the horde is written to the admin log.

changeoption.effect: Saves the ini file at once. Changing `Password` also sets the server's password, changing `ClientCommandFilter` reloads the filter, and on a Steam server the Steam settings are applied again. Every change is written to the admin log.

stats.effect: `/stats list` lists the statistics, `/stats version` prints the game version, `/stats <statistic> list` lists its counters, `/stats <statistic> all` prints every value and `/stats <statistic> <counter>` one value. Anything else, `/stats help` included, prints the help text again.
